shops.name: Corner Stall
shops.tagline: Leather bags, shoes, mugs and denim from a small market stall

products.title: Tan Leather Briefcase with Buckles
products.summary: A structured tan leather briefcase featuring dual top handles, a detachable shoulder strap, and front buckle closures.
products.description: This rectangular briefcase is crafted from smooth tan leather with visible contrast stitching along the seams. It features two rolled top handles and a detachable, adjustable shoulder strap attached via metal D-rings. The front is secured by a flap closure with two vertical leather straps and silver-tone metal buckles.

products.title: Large Tan Leather Tote Bag with Front Flap Pocket
products.summary: Large tan leather tote bag with a front flap pocket and top handles.
products.description: A large, structured leather tote bag featuring a minimalist, slouchy silhouette. The bag is crafted from smooth, full-grain leather in a warm tan hue, showing natural texture and slight variations in tone. It features a prominent, rectangular external pocket on the front with a wide, folded-over flap. The bag has two sturdy top handles attached to the sides with metal hardware, allowing it to be carried by hand or on the shoulder.

products.title: White Ceramic Mug with Hand-Drawn 'Fill Me Up With Coffee' Text
products.summary: A white ceramic mug with a playful, hand-drawn 'Fill me up with coffee' text design.
products.description: A white ceramic mug featuring a black, hand-drawn style typographic design. The text on the visible side reads 'FILL ME UP WITH COFFEE' in a stacked, casual font. The mug has a standard cylindrical shape with a smooth, glossy finish and a C-shaped handle.

products.title: White Ceramic Mug with Gold Handle
products.summary: White ceramic mug with a gold handle
products.description: A white ceramic mug with a smooth, glossy finish and a contrasting gold-colored handle. The mug has a classic cylindrical shape with a slightly tapered base, designed for everyday use with hot or cold beverages.

products.title: Cognac Leather Horsebit Loafers - Men's Slip-On Dress Shoes
products.summary: Cognac leather horsebit loafers with a moccasin toe and stacked heel.
products.description: A pair of men's slip-on loafers crafted from smooth, cognac-colored leather. The shoes feature a classic penny loafer silhouette with a moccasin-stitched toe and a brass-tone metal horsebit accent across the vamp. The construction includes a visible welt and a stacked leather heel, finished with a dark interior lining.

products.title: Indigo Denim Jacket with Mustard-Yellow Contrast Collar
products.summary: Indigo denim jacket with a contrasting mustard-yellow collar and plaid lining.
products.description: A long-sleeved, button-front denim jacket in a dark indigo wash. It features a contrasting, textured mustard-yellow collar and a visible plaid lining at the neck and cuffs. The jacket includes two chest pockets with buttoned flaps, a front button closure, and a straight hem. The denim has a visible weave and is detailed with contrast stitching.
